findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant ownership check
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: At current head eec690c53868a61fd80a4c26adb9d932276ac84f, src/access.ts:2 still returns true unconditionally. The full base-to-head diff replaces `userTenant === documentTenant` with `true`, so mismatched tenant identifiers remain authorized.
